objects.name: Detection technique coverage: github-enterprise-repository-deleted
objects.description: The following analytic detects when a user deletes a repository in GitHub Enterprise. The detection monitors GitHub Enterprise audit logs for repository deletion events, which could indicate unauthorized removal of critical source code and project resources. For a SOC, identifying repository deletions is crucial as it may signal account compromise, insider threats, or malicious attempts to destroy intellectual property and disrupt development operations.
